title: Terms & Conditions
intro: This page contains placeholder wording for layout purposes. Final legal text will be provided and approved by OneVaya Travel & Tourism.

sections.heading: 1. About us
body: OneVaya Travel & Tourism ("OneVaya", "we", "us") is a travel company based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. These terms apply to all enquiries, quotes and bookings made with us.

sections.heading: 2. Quotes and bookings
body: Information shown on our website, including prices, is indicative. A booking is confirmed only when you accept a written quote and we confirm the booking with the relevant supplier.
Plans created in the Trip Builder or suggested by our AI assistant are requests, not confirmed bookings.

sections.heading: 3. Prices and payment
body: Prices are quoted in UAE Dirhams unless stated otherwise. Payment terms are shown on your quote and invoice. Payments received are recorded in your My OneVaya account.

sections.heading: 4. Travel documents
body: You are responsible for holding a valid passport, visas and any health documents required for your journey.

sections.heading: 5. Supplier terms
body: Flights, hotels and experiences are provided by third-party suppliers whose own terms and conditions also apply.

sections.heading: 6. Liability
body: We act with reasonable care and skill in arranging your travel. Our liability is limited as permitted by the laws of the United Arab Emirates.

sections.heading: 7. Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Emirate of Dubai and the federal laws of the United Arab Emirates.

title: Privacy Policy
intro: This page contains placeholder wording for layout purposes. Final legal text will be provided and approved by OneVaya Travel & Tourism.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
body: Contact details, travel preferences, passport and traveller details needed for bookings, and messages you send us.

sections.heading: 2. How we use it
body: To respond to enquiries, prepare quotes, make bookings, share travel documents and provide customer support.

sections.heading: 3. Sharing
body: We share only the information needed with airlines, hotels and partners to fulfil your bookings. We never sell your data.

sections.heading: 4. Document security
body: Travel documents are stored in private cloud storage and are only available through secure links in your account.

sections.heading: 5. AI assistant
body: Our AI assistant uses OneVaya-approved information and, for signed-in customers, their own booking details to answer questions.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
body: You can ask to access, correct or delete your personal information by contacting us.

title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
intro: This page contains placeholder wording for layout purposes. Final legal text will be provided and approved by OneVaya Travel & Tourism.

sections.heading: 1. Cancelling a booking
body: Cancellation requests must be made in writing or through My OneVaya. Your travel designer will confirm any charges before processing.

sections.heading: 2. Supplier charges
body: Airlines, hotels and experience providers apply their own cancellation rules. Non-refundable fares and rates cannot be refunded.

sections.heading: 3. Experiences
body: Most experiences can be cancelled free of charge up to 24–48 hours before the start time. Later cancellations or no-shows may be charged in full.

sections.heading: 4. Refunds
body: Approved refunds are returned using the original payment method where possible, within the timeframe advised by your travel designer.

sections.heading: 5. Changes
body: Changes are subject to availability and any supplier fees. Request changes from your booking in My OneVaya.
